title: Back at the hotel over Minton's; Sabby Lewis hires him
summary: The Southern tour ended in New York, he lodged again over Minton's on 118th Street and Sabby Lewis hired him there.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And then was it after the tour that you took through the South with Tiny Bradshaw that you ...where did that tour end up?
Back in New York. They all ended up back in New York. And then that's when Sabby Lewis came by Minton's ...right back at Minton's... and he heard me, he hired me.
You were right back living in the same hotel as when you first came. It was like the place to be.
Yeah. The name will come to me.
Oh yeah, right over it. I've heard of that...
So Sabby Lewis came in and he heard me and he hired me. And that's how that happened.
